title: Hopper FP8 dark-launch + canary sampler for E4M3/E5M2 quant profiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a controlled dark-launch and canary sampling harness to validate E4M3/E5M2 FP8 quantization profiles on Hopper GPUs. This ticket covers the orchestration, telemetry gating, and rollback heuristics needed to surface stability regressions and accuracy drift before any customer-visible activation. Goal: provide an automated, observable pathway from shadow evaluation to progressive traffic canaries with safety gates for accuracy and latency.
acceptance_criteria: Dark-launch agent can deploy FP8 profile variants in shadow mode against 100% of internal canary traffic without impacting production responses
Canary sampler exposes configurable sampling fractions (0.1% -> 2%) and can be tied to routes/models via Redwood routing policies
Telemetry pipeline reports token-level loss delta, end-to-end latency P95, NVL (numerical validation loss) and stability_score for each profile hourly
Automatic gating policy blocks canary escalation when stability_score < 0.92 or token-loss-delta > 0.015 or latency-P95 regression > 20ms
Rollback action executes automated fallback to INT8/FP32 variant and triggers alerting + postmortem template when gating conditions fail three consecutive hours
Runbook and dashboard links included and trainers/research notified for any accuracy regressions
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (shadow-only): deploy profiles in dark-run across 10% of internal synthetic traffic for 72 hours
Phase 1 (internal canary): enable canary sampler at 0.1% customer-like traffic for 24-48 hours, monitor metrics
Phase 2 (progressive ramp): 0.5% -> 1% -> 2% with 12-hour hold windows and gating checks at each step
Phase 3 (opt-in beta): enable for customers who opt into beta (documented opt-in flow), maintain canary sampler for 7 days
Escalation: if gating fails at any step, revert to last-safe quant profile and notify SRE/ML leads
test_plan: Synthetic golden prompts suite (2k prompts) run every hour with deterministic seeds to compute perplexity and output token fingerprints
A/B offline accuracy tests against evaluation harness comparing FP32 baseline to E4M3 and E5M2 activations
Load test with continuous batching to validate latency P95 under production-like QPS
Fault injection: simulate KV cache misses and shard transient GPU OOM to validate hysteresis and autoswitch behavior
Telemetry reliability tests: ensure alerts trigger within 5 minutes for gating violations
telemetry_metrics: stability_score (0-1) computed from token flip rate + token-level discrepancy
quant_activation_rate (% of requests using FP8 path)
notes: We observed a class of instability during early e4m3 activations when sequence-length variance > 1024; include adaptive kernel-selection guard
Prefer conservative early gating thresholds: start with stability_score 0.95 for internal canaries, relax to 0.92 for extended regression tuning experiments
Fallback chain: FP8(E5M2) -> FP8(E4M3 with conservative scaling) -> INT8 -> FP32
Consider adding a drift detector that triggers retraining of scale tables or re-run of calibration job when NVL trend positive for 6 hours
Coordinate with SRE to reserve burst capacity in Dedicated pools during canary ramps to avoid capacity-driven fallbacks
